problems.q: I cannot register for a course
steps: Check the class is open for registration in the planner (status and seats).
Check the official registration window and your registration conditions on the student portal.
If the class is full or missing, ask your school office first, then the Academic Affairs Office.
Take a screenshot of the grade in the student portal.
Ask the lecturer or the school office first.
Ask the Academic Affairs Office how to submit a grade review. Deadlines are set by the university, so ask quickly.

problems.q: I have not received my student card
steps: Ask the Office of Student Affairs. Bring your passport.
Ask whether a temporary proof of enrolment is available.

problems.q: I need to ask about health insurance
steps: Ask the Office of Student Affairs how student health insurance works for your programme.
Keep any card or receipt you receive.

problems.q: I need help with my visa or residence
steps: Look at your visa expiry date now.
Official page (2021): ask for an extension at least 1 month before expiry. Late applications can be refused or fined.
Degree-seeking students: ask OSA which office handles your file. Non-degree students: international office, htdn@hust.edu.vn.
Do not wait for the last week.
Go to the campus security office or ask any security guard.
Describe the item and where you were. Keep your phone number ready.

problems.q: I have a question about scholarships
steps: Ask the Office of Student Affairs about HUST scholarships.
If your scholarship comes from a government or home institution, ask your sponsor and the international office.

problems.q: I need help with the dormitory
steps: Go to the Dormitory Management Center in B9, rooms 101-102, or call the published number.

problems.q: I cannot log in to the student portal
steps: Try the official password-reset option first.
If it fails, the Academic Affairs Office handles portal password resets (project brief).
Report it to the police and get a written report.
Contact your embassy.
Tell OSA or the international office the same day. They need to update your records.
See Emergency Help for steps and phrases.
Ask the School of Foreign Languages (D4, rooms 207-208) whether Vietnamese classes are offered for your programme.
Contact your school or faculty office and ask who your advisor is.
